windowTitle: Candidate Console identity fix for the TKE two-mode business closure

rootCause.fact: The Console identity is a build-time fact. `apps/console-ui/src/app/console-identity.ts` reads `VITE_CONSOLE_IDENTITY`, and `apps/console-ui/src/console-model.ts` / `console-router.ts` add the customer `智能体` (`/console/agents`) and Publisher surfaces only when it equals `cloud`. The product Dockerfile default is the neutral `legacy`, and no Cloud build path (Candidate/Release/Qualification) passed `cloud`.
rootCause.consequence: Every deployed Candidate image baked the legacy Console bundle, so the customer Console had no `智能体` navigation/route even though the account and BFF surfaces existed.

change.candidateWorkflow: .github/workflows/build-opl-cloud-candidate.yml passes --build-arg VITE_CONSOLE_IDENTITY=cloud and reads back opl.cloud.console-identity == "cloud" from both the amd64 and arm64 emitted images.
change.boundaryValidator: tools/validate-product-boundary.mjs rejects a Candidate that does not build the cloud Console identity or does not read it back.
change.gate: tests/tools/opl-cloud-candidate-console-identity.test.ts asserts the build arg, the label readback, and the Dockerfile's neutral default plus identity label.
change.dockerfile: Unchanged: it keeps the neutral `legacy` default and LABEL opl.cloud.console-identity, which owner-topology and owneridentity declare as the image's default identity selection; the Candidate, as the shipped cloud product, selects `cloud` explicitly.

ownerOnlyCandidateDispatch.guard: build-opl-cloud-candidate.yml requires github.actor == github.repository_owner == gaofeng21cn == triggering_actor
ownerOnlyCandidateDispatch.result: skipped by the owner-only job guard; the repository owner must dispatch the Candidate build

requiredInput.product_sha: the frozen branch head of codex/candidate-cloud-console-identity

claimBoundary: This receipt claims the fix source and its gates, plus a green local verification and PR CI. It does not claim a built Candidate image, an installed product, or that the deployed Console now shows 智能体; those require an owner-dispatched Candidate build and the Instance protected deployment chain.
notRun: Candidate image build (owner-only dispatch; the RenDeHuang attempt was skipped).
Instance Deploy / Deployment Verification / Qualification Decision / admission for the new Candidate.
Real Console purchase and the two-mode Workspace acceptance.
